background: West Bromwich Building Society is a mutual in the West Midlands, funded by retail savings from its branches and lending on residential mortgages, having wound down the commercial property and buy-to-let books that hurt it after the financial crisis.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the society. Against UK building societies leverage of 6.5% is above the peer median and CET1 of 16.4% just below it, but liquidity is the weak spot, with LCR of 167% and NSFR of 143% both in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Sep 2023 CET1 has fallen 1.6 points, leverage 1.0 points and LCR 52 points, in figures to 31 Mar 2026.
